# MuallimAI — [Observance logistics + fiqh guidance / Islam — Hajj/Umrah group leaders]
**Claim:** A scholar-guide (muallim) decision-support tool that gives the certified Islamic scholar leading a Hajj or Umrah group an on-demand fiqh query interface — scoped to Hajj/Umrah ritual law across the four major madhabs — combined with a live group-status dashboard, so the muallim can resolve "what is the ruling if my pilgrim performed tawaf before wudu?" in real time rather than calling back to a mufti in a different time zone.
**Why-now capability:** Retrieval-augmented generation over structured fiqh corpora (Minhaj al-Muslim, Fiqh al-Muyassar, Al-Mawsuah al-Fiqhiyyah) is now reliable enough to produce madhab-attributed answers with traceable citations. Arabic LLM instruction-following (GPT-4o Arabic capability, Jais-30B, AceGPT) crossed the reliability bar in 2024-2025. The model scope is narrow: only Hajj/Umrah ibadah rulings across 4 madhabs, making verifiable grounding tractable for a small team.
**Mechanism / rationale:** The captive-distribution wedge: Muslim Pro, Umma, HayYa, HalalTrip serve individual pilgrims, not the certified guide. Agency-ops platforms (HajjFlow, EzUmrah, Umrah360, Mansaky) are logistics ERPs with no fiqh layer. OnlyHaj.ai targets pilgrim-facing itinerary management, not scholar-facing ritual rulings. The muallim is a licensed, paid professional (Saudi Ministry of Hajj certification) personally accountable for group ritual validity — he pays for a tool that protects that accountability. Payer: the muallim directly ($15-25/month) or the Hajj agency as a per-group add-on ($50-150/group). The proprietary corpus deepens: documented edge-case rulings and the muallim's chosen madhab preference compound over time.
**Novelty:** No verified shipped tool provides the muallim (guide) — as distinct from the pilgrim — with real-time madhab-attributed ritual fiqh QA. Agency ERPs are administrative; pilgrim apps are devotional. The professional accountability layer for the certified guide is unoccupied.
**Test:** Partner with 3 licensed muallims on the next Umrah season. Run a pilot where they query MuallimAI for ritual edge cases during live groups. Measure: (a) queries per group, (b) muallim-rated accuracy (verified against their own mufti consultations post-hoc), (c) stated willingness to pay. Success: >80% answer accuracy, >5 queries per group, 2 of 3 muallims commit to paying.
**Assumptions:** (1) Hajj/Umrah fiqh corpus is bounded and digitized enough for reliable RAG in 3-6 months. (2) Saudi certification structures create a reachable B2B buyer channel. (3) The product disclaims that answers are reference material, not binding fatwa — edge cases requiring fatwa route to the muallim's scholarly superior. Doctrinal-accuracy gate: all answers cite source + madhab; any question touching the validity of a completed ritual (possible qada/kaffara) flags "consult your mufti." Licensing: classical fiqh texts are public domain in Arabic; translations internally produced or licensed.
